sample.about: Outside research: parking / access hunt (Brandon Oct 31 5:14 PM), US 5,733 + Canada 5,511 parks with no parking point. 'layers' = the agency-wide parking / access / facility point layers found (for the access bot to pin-test like its own sources); 'rows' per park. LAYER FOUND often means the agency's layer exists but has no point for this park (see notes). Nothing live without chat 11.

https://services1.arcgis.com/7HDiw78fcUi.agency: Alaska DNR, Division of Parks and Outdoor Recreation
https://services1.arcgis.com/7HDiw78fcUi.field: FACILITYTYPE (Access Point, Airplane Landing Strip, Bike Park, Boat Dock, Boat Launch, Boat Ramp, Boat Takeout, Boating - Motorized, Boating - Non-Motorized, Canoe / Kayak Access, Denali Bike Trailhead, Dog Park, Entrance Station, Gateway Sign, ...)

https://services1.arcgis.com/KbxwQRRfWyE.field: FET_TYPE (coded: 7 TRAIL HEAD, 8 PARKING AREA, 2 WATER BASED SITE, 4 DAY USE SITE, 1 INFORMATION CENTER SITE); FET_SUBTYPE gives detail

https://mapservices.nps.gov/arcgis/rest/.field: POITYPE (access types: Trailhead); POINAME; filter UNITCODE = 'DENA'

https://services3.arcgis.com/9Ij3DUv1U32.field: NAME; FROM_DESC (coordinates as text); filter AGENCY = 'FWS' AND FLMA_UNIT_ID = 'Alaska Maritime National Wildlife Refuge'

US-4570.Name: Iditarod National Historic Trail
US-4570.Notes: No official federal layer names this site, so its managing agency is not confirmed and no agency-wide layer applies. Checked by name: NPS Land Resources Division boundary list and NPS Public POIs; BLM NLCS Wilderness Areas and National Monuments/NCAs polygons and BLM National Recreation Site Points; FWS National Realty Boundaries and FWS National Wilderness Boundaries; USDA Forest Service EDW Recreation Opportunities.

Point type field: FACILITYTYPE (Access Point, Airplane Landing Strip, Bike Park, Boat Dock, Boat Launch, Boat Ramp, Boat Takeout, Boating - Motorized, Boating - Non-Motorized, Canoe / Kayak Access, Denali Bike Trailhead, Dog Park, Entrance Station, Gateway Sign, ...).
